convention.notes: Ads that keep today's KiriMedia slugs are parsed best-effort (objective, brand, concept, format and any % / sale wording) and counted as untagged. The prefix 'BM |' is what marks an ad as tagged; DPA / catalog ads do not need it.

notes: Metrics and verdicts use the 7 settled days 2026-10-27 – 2026-11-02; the last 2 days are left out because Meta keeps attributing purchases to them.
ROAS is Meta's platform-reported purchase value ÷ spend (7d click / 1d view), revenue not profit. Use it to rank creatives against each other, not as business ROAS.

Hook rate = 3-second video views ÷ impressions, video-format ads only (format from the ad name / creative video id; stills and catalog ads that log a few autoplays are left out). Hold rate = ThruPlays ÷ plays.
Frequency is the average DAILY frequency (impressions ÷ summed daily reach); the feed has no period-level reach.
Market comes from the ad name (SWE/NOR/FIN/DK), as on the Meta creatives tab. Ads named for 'EU' fall back to the campaign's market.
Results by tag cover 28 settled days (2026-10-06 – 2026-11-02) so a tag has enough spend behind it. Untagged ads are parsed from today's names and counted as untagged.
Verdicts never act on anything: this page is read-only. Pause or scale in Ads Manager.
